goal: Retire obsolete imported planning hosts while preserving every live execution and conversation
invariants: Only an explicit consolidation receipt nominates a planning identity
Any current ownership in any project or any running execution blocks retirement
Ownership and execution writes remain fenced until the attested logical host exits
An unknown host, execution host or uncertain custody read cannot be killed by cleanup
Retirement preserves sessions and chat history without closing a bead, advancing progress or granting approval
A completed retirement is recorded once and is not repeated
The active detached cockpit contains Commander without a permanent Manager window
